A member of the Houthis’ political bureau has issued a sharp warning: any country that stands alongside Saudi Arabia will be considered to have committed an “act of aggression” against Yemen. The statement came from Mohammed al-Bukhaiti after Egyptian lawmakers approved President Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi’s request to support Saudi Arabia in countering Houthi attacks.
Produced & Edited By Ankit Kumar
